tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when Elena and Rowan Pippinwisp report a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. Update the address, statement delivery preferences, and planning assumptions for their new Reno townhouse residence and tax‑residency trail.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow‑up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-03 is to update the address, statement delivery preferences, and planning assumptions for the new residence and tax-residency trail.

tickets.title: Request and organize estate document copies
tickets.text: Ask Elena and Rowan Pippinwisp to provide current copies of core estate documents, including will, revocable trust if applicable, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designations, trustee or executor contact information, and any recent amendment pages. Store received documents according to firm procedures and note missing items for follow‑up. Collect the current will, trust amendment pages, powers of attorney, health care directive, and beneficiary‑designation confirmations as identified in the estate‑binder follow‑up.
tickets.evidence: The unresolved estate-binder follow-up dated 2024-09-20 is collection of those current documents and confirmations.

tickets.title: Review equity award evidence and planning criteria
tickets.text:
Collect and review:
- Current equity award statement or portal export.
- Grant agreements and plan documents for each award type.
- Vesting schedule, expiration dates, blackout windows, and trading policy limits.
- Option type, strike price, current estimated value, and exercise rules.
- RSU release schedule, withholding method, and sell‑to‑cover details.
- ESPP purchase periods, discount, holding period rules, and payroll contribution rate.
- Concentration exposure compared with total household net worth and investable assets.
- Tax evidence needed for ordinary income, AMT, capital gains, and estimated payments.
- Employment status risks, change‑in‑control provisions, and post‑termination exercise windows.
- Client goals for diversification, cash needs, charitable giving, and retirement income.

Flag missing evidence, conflicts between documents, tax questions for the CPA, and transactions requiring pre‑clearance before any recommendation is finalized. Review Elena and Rowan Pippinwisp's restricted stock units, incentive stock options, and blackout‑window notices together as requested.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-13 is to review those employer-equity materials together.

tickets.title: Coordinate tax reserve estimates with Jasper
tickets.text: Coordinate estimated tax reserves with Jasper Thimblefern for Elena and Rowan Pippinwisp before modeling any employer‑share sale or option exercise.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-18 is coordination on those estimated tax reserves.

tickets.title: Year-End Deadline Sweep
tickets.text: Review the timing of year‑end charitable transfers for Elena and Rowan Pippinwisp, aligning the cash‑gift pattern and tax projections with their charitable goals.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-11-15 is to review year-end charitable transfer timing with their cash-gift pattern and tax projections.
